findings.evidence: The honorific key point said 께서 and an honorific verb must always occur together and that marking only one is broken. Ordinary 이/가 can accompany an honorific verb depending on discourse, and 먹으세요 itself contains subject honorification even though 드세요 is the conventional lexical honorific.
findings.fix: Made verb honorification the core rule, scoped 께서 to careful speech, and described 드세요 as the conventional respectful default rather than the only grammatical form.
